_help.accent: brand color (hex) for the spoken word, the hook word and the progress bar
_help.textColor: color of the other caption words
_help.font: Cairo | Tajawal | Almarai | Noto Kufi Arabic
_help.captionSize: font size in px on a 1080x1920 frame (70-110)
_help.captionY: vertical position of the captions, 0 = top, 1 = bottom
_help.hook: optional title shown on top for the first seconds; empty = none
_help.hookAccentWord: the word inside the hook painted in the accent color
_help.hookSeconds: how long the hook stays on screen
_help.music: optional path to an MP3 you own (relative to the work folder or absolute); null = none
_help.zoomOnCuts: alternate a slight punch-in on every cut so jump cuts feel intentional
_help.progressBar: thin accent bar on top that fills while the reel plays
_help.remove: extra parts to delete, as [start, end] in seconds of the ORIGINAL video
